Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football | National GPL 2026/27: Hearts boss Kapor wary of ‘difficult’ Holy Stars encounter Source : Lawrence Degraft Baidoo 22 October 2026 11:14am Audio By Carbonatix
Hearts of Oak head coach Nebojsa Kapor has cautioned his side ahead of their Ghana Premier League game against Basake Holy Stars.
The two teams face each other on matchday eight of the league, with both teams hoping to continue their winning run from last weekend.
The Phobians have won all of their last two games against Port City and Vision FC, while Holy Stars have won one and lost one in the same period, losing to Bibiani GoldStars and claiming victory over Bechem United.
Each team has claimed one win in the last four meetings between Hearts and Holy Stars, and despite two points separating the two teams on the league table, Kapor has warned his side not to be complacent.
"We are not going to say we are a better team and we will win. No, never. We are really going to approach them very deep from every single department and from every single individual player," he said.
"Every game here is very difficult. Especially from the mentality side, we have to face this game very tough."
The fixture is scheduled to take place at the University of Ghana Stadium on Friday, October 23.
